notes:
New Features:

- Redlight HD now hands Kodi the browser-style HLS media playlist ("chunks.m3u8") with the Nimble session ID from the fresh master manifest instead of keeping Kodi on the expiring signed master URL.
- Existing .com EOF classification and recovery remain active as a fallback if the browser-style Redlight session still becomes unavailable.

Improvements:

- Adult-TV-Channels.com is now shown in green and OXAX in orange in both the Site root and generated playlist channel names.
- Release Notes scrolling now also handles Kodi Scroll Up/Scroll Down actions used by remote-control clients such as Yatse, in addition to directional keys, Page Up/Down and the mouse wheel.
- The post-update Release Notes window restores centered, slightly larger green/orange/red section headings while keeping the note bodies scrollable.

Bugfixes:

- Avoids Redlight HD remaining on the one-hour signed .com master playlist after startup; the Edge HAR comparison showed that the website continues playback through a session-specific "chunks.m3u8" playlist instead.
